# Joomla 3.x UTD

> Joomla 3.x UTD ("up-to-date") is a maintained distribution of the Joomla 3.x content management system by JoomlaWorks: security fixes backported from Joomla 4, 5 and 6 (and its own), support for PHP 7.1 to 8.5 and current MySQL/MariaDB, and fixes for long-standing Joomla 3 bugs, on top of Joomla 3.10.20. It is not an official Joomla release. Existing Joomla 3 sites update in place and keep their extensions and templates.

- Source code and issues: https://github.com/joomlaworks/joomla-3.x
- Latest release package: https://github.com/joomlaworks/joomla-3.x/releases/download/rolling/joomla-latest.zip
- Update feed for System Update (Joomla! Update before 3.19), Update Channel "Custom URL": https://joomlaworks.github.io/joomla-3.x/list.xml
- Requirements: PHP 7.1 or newer (7.4 recommended, tested up to 8.5); MySQL 5.5.3+, MariaDB 5.5+, PostgreSQL 9.5+, SQL Server 2008 R2+, or SQLite 3.37+ (experimental, PHP 7.4+)
- Licence: GNU General Public License, version 2 or later

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joomlaworks/joomla-3.x/main/README.md): what the distribution is, a short summary of each release, upgrading and installing, supported PHP versions and databases
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joomlaworks/joomla-3.x/main/CHANGELOG.md): every change of every release in detail (security fixes, new features, improvements, bug fixes)
- [AI assistants and the command line](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joomlaworks/joomla-3.x/main/AI-GUIDE.md): the built-in MCP server (client setup, permissions) and the command line `cli/joomla.php` (recipes, command reference)
- [Command line guide for developers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joomlaworks/joomla-3.x/main/CLI-GUIDE.md): adding commands to the command line and the MCP server from an extension (console plugins)
- [API guide for developers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joomlaworks/joomla-3.x/main/API-GUIDE.md): what the distribution adds to Joomla 3's PHP and JavaScript API for extensions and templates

## Updating a site

- From the administrator: System Update, with the update feed above as its Custom URL
- From the command line, on Joomla 3.x UTD 3.17 or newer: `php cli/joomla.php core:update`
- From the command line, on any other Joomla 3.x site: extract the release package over the site, remove the `installation` folder, then run `php cli/joomla.php core:update:finalise` (it applies the database changes; copying the files alone doesn't)
